description: A secure Stripe payment page for a DRAFT election's fee, for the person you act for to pay by card. It creates the page and charges nothing: hand the person the link. The page asks for exactly the price get_election_price reports. Publishing follows the payment either way: the election's page, where Stripe returns them, publishes it once the payment lands, and publish_election with after_payment: true publishes it from here or answers already_published. Refused when nothing is owed (free, already paid, or covered by a plan) and when the prepaid balance covers the fee, because publishing then takes it without a card.

election.description: The election's id or slug, from list_elections or create_election_draft.

name: create_checkout_link
title: A card payment page for a draft election
